question: Does mean-filling a predicted tiny box provide TP/nonduplicate-FP information beyond frozen ordinary calibration, native logits, simple patch texture and equal-area nearby mean-filling?
difference: Candidate17 removed distant context in zoomed patches to change labels. This screen deletes within-box texture at the original source-view scale, keeps the original native query and class fixed, and learns only diagnostic binary readouts. It does not reopen candidate17 or any stopped deployment recipe.
selection: Before any decoding, hash and scan existing output/analysis/*/plan.json image stems. Exclude those exact diagnostic images. Group remaining train images by first7-character sequence prefix. Sort groups by SHA256('candidate56-scene-v1:'+prefix), use first192groups, one image per group chosen by SHA256('candidate56-image-v1:'+stem). First64fit,next64screen,last64confirmation. Splits share no sequence prefix; other frames of these sequences may have appeared in historical diagnostics, and the detector/calibrator saw training data. No unseen-detector-data claim.
reference: Actual frozen FP16 square960 global+four-tile predictor, existing fixed NMS and ordinary calibration with ignores=[]. No GT enters predictions, query selection, patches or features. Repeated original global-view prediction/logit replay per image must be exact.
queries: From complete ordinary calibration reference, consider score>=0.25 and predicted area*(640/max(original_size))^2<256. Sort rows by SHA256('candidate56-query-v1:'+stem+':'+row_index), take at most12 before GT filtering and patch/query availability. Use source view from calibration origins. Within that view select the native row maximizing IoU*sigmoid(predicted_class_logit), among rows with IoU>=0.5 to reference coordinates mapped to local view; stable first-index ties. Save full original native logits/decoded boxes and local kept predictions, avoiding inverse-mapping ambiguity.
patches: Own rectangle is floor lower/ceil upper reference box in original source-view pixels, clipped to view. Sham has identical integer width/height and is shifted by +2width,-2width,+2height,-2height in that priority, first fully in-view choice. No GT-based avoidance: sham may contain another object. Missing nonempty rectangle, valid sham or native query means unavailable for all arms. Replace each patch by np.rint(per-channel patch mean).astype(uint8); other pixels bit-identical. This deletes texture, not a plausible target-absent counterfactual or guaranteed object removal.
features: Common base: original raw calibration features,10class-onehot,5source-view-onehot,10original fixed-query native logits,query IoU,and own/sham per-channel mean and std (12texture features). Extra vectors are original minus perturbed ten-class logits at the same saved native row. No GT or perturbed query rematching.

arms.shuffled: Base plus10sham-deletion and10own deltas from another image of the same predicted class in the same split. Donor is first row from a different image after query in cyclic SHA256('candidate56-donor-v1:'+stem+':'+reference_index) order; may reuse donors, is not necessarily a permutation. If no different-image donor exists for a class, own/shuffled extra columns are both zero for that class. Batch-transductive negative control, not a deployable arm.

labels: Greedy class-aware IoU0.5 matching of the entire unmodified reference in original score order at0.25. Historical individual-ignore-IoF>0.5 and unmatched same-class-IoU>=0.5 duplicate exclusion apply only to supervised/diagnostic population, equally to every arm. Fit and evaluate only selected available nonignored nonduplicate rows.
fit: Four CPUfloat64 convex logistic residual fits with offset=logit(original calibrated score). Fit-only shared per-column mean/std, floor1e-6. Own and donor vectors share normalization estimated from own fit vectors; sham uses its own fit statistics. Ordinary BCE+.005*sum(theta^2), unpenalized intercept; zero initialization,L-BFGS-B maxiter200,ftol1e-12,gtol1e-6. Require solver success and gradient_inf<=1e-5. No detector updates, fit/feature/threshold/sample tuning or holdout normalization.
metrics: Separately report screen64 and confirmation64 NLL/AUROC on identical selected fixed queries. Paired pooled-NLL bootstrap400draws of all64images per split, default_rng0. Keep empty images in resampling. Confirmation uses identical saved fit coefficients, no refit or rule choice after screen.
pass: REPLICATED_TEXTURE_DELETION_INFORMATION_SUPPORTS_SEPARATE_DEPLOYMENT_AND_COST_PILOT. A pass is not official AP, detector-training or novelty authorization; require fixed deployment gains, acceptable measured cost or amortization evidence, and closer prior differentiation.
fail: STOP_THIS_PAIRED_MEAN_FILL_TEXTURE_DELETION_RECIPE. Do not change fill, patch size/location, selected scene/query counts, native association, model, features, regularization or gates to rescue this result.
budget: 192JPEG decodes;960original frozen forwards+192global identity replays+at most4608perturbed forwards, plus existing one predictor warmup. Four small convex fits;zero detector updates/AP. Both halves may be extracted in the one registered run regardless of screen outcome; no adaptive extra images.
prior_boundary: D-RISE2006.03204v2 already uses masking for detector explanations and context biases. FACTOR2605.03294v1 already recalibrates detection from paired non-causal attribute perturbations. CQTR2609.06581v1 already uses counterfactual scale and internal query evidence for small objects. Mean filling, sensitivity or frozen inference alone is not new. This matched within-box versus nearby diagnostic must show new useful evidence before considering a differentiated method.
